stories.title: Australia's S&P/ASX 200 Falls 0.71% at the Close
stories.summary: Australian shares closed lower, with the S&P/ASX 200 index down 0.71% on the day, Investing.com reported. The report did not give a sector or stock-level breakdown.
stories.whyItMatters: The close gives an early read on risk appetite in Asia-Pacific trading ahead of the next global session.
whatToWatch: How the index opens in the next session
questions: Was the move broad-based or led by a few sectors?

sources.title: Australia stocks lower at close of trade; S&P/ASX 200 down 0.71%

stories.title: RedCloud to Carry Out 100-for-1 Reverse Stock Split Tuesday
stories.summary: RedCloud will complete a 100-to-1 reverse stock split on Tuesday, Investing.com reported. The split will cut the number of shares outstanding while lifting the per-share price by the same ratio.
stories.whyItMatters: Reverse splits often point to a company managing its share price, sometimes to meet exchange listing rules.
whatToWatch: Share price and volume right after the split
questions: Does RedCloud face a listing compliance issue?

sources.title: RedCloud to implement 100-to-1 reverse stock split Tuesday

stories.title: Jindal Power Signs $470 Million Loan for Botswana Power Project
stories.summary: Jindal Power has signed a $470 million loan to help fund a power project in Botswana, according to a report cited by Investing.com. No further terms were disclosed.
stories.whyItMatters: The deal points to continued financing activity in African power infrastructure, relevant for investors tracking emerging-market project debt.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of loan terms and lenders
questions: Which banks are providing the loan?
When is the project expected to be complete?

sources.title: Jindal Power signs $470 mln loan for Botswana power project - report

stories.title: Microsoft Still Working to Fix Outage Hitting Teams and Outlook
stories.summary: Microsoft said it is still trying to fix a major outage affecting Teams and Outlook, Investing.com reported. The outage was ongoing at the time of the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Teams and Outlook outages disrupt work for businesses worldwide and can pressure sentiment toward Microsoft.
whatToWatch: Confirmation that services are fully restored
questions: How many users or regions are affected?

sources.title: Microsoft says still attempting to fix major outage hitting Teams, Outlook

stories.title: SMFG Raises Full-Year Profit Forecast 12% After Strong First Half
stories.summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group raised its full-year profit forecast by 12%, after first-half profit surged, Investing.com reported.
stories.whyItMatters: The upgrade signals strength at one of Japan's largest banking groups, a read-through for investors watching Japanese financials.
whatToWatch: Forecast updates from peer Japanese banks
questions: What drove the first-half profit surge?

sources.title: SMFG raises full-year profit forecast by 12% after first-half profit surges

whatToWatch: A full parliamentary vote on the budget

stories.title: Gold Rebounds Above $3,900 After 13-Month Low, Still Set for Weekly Loss
stories.summary: Gold prices rebounded above $3,900 an ounce after touching a 13-month low, Investing.com reported. The metal is still on track for a loss on the week.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold moves track shifting rate expectations and risk sentiment, making them a closely watched macro signal.
whatToWatch: This week's closing level for gold
Any shift in rate-cut expectations that could move the dollar
questions: What drove gold down to the 13-month low?
